title: AIActTriage
description: Triage decision under EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) for a single AI use case. Consumed by ai-use-case intake of record, model-card-builder (Annex IV deltas), genai-pre-prod-review, llm-vendor-evidence-review, board-ai-risk-pack, and the EU-applicability flag for downstream skills.

scope_id.description: Links to scoping record if supplied.

triager.description: Function or role; never named individual.

legal_reviewer.description: Legal sign-off audience; the triage is a draft until legal/compliance review.

in_scope.description: True if any of eu_users, eu_operations, eu_data_subjects, market_placement is true.

eu_users.description: Output is used by people in the EU.

eu_operations.description: System is operated from an EU establishment.

eu_data_subjects.description: Personal data of EU data subjects is in scope.

market_placement.description: System is placed on the EU market or put into service in the EU (Article 2).

exposure_basis.description: Short narrative of the EU touch-point.

basis.description: Why the firm holds this role under Article 3.

counterparty.description: Other operator(s) in the chain (e.g., the vendor that is the provider when the firm is deployer).

prohibited_screen.description: Article 5 sub-practice screen. Each item is screened explicitly; do not omit a sub-practice.

annex_iii_row.description: Cited Annex III row when primary is high_risk_annex_III (e.g., 'Annex III(5)(b)' for credit scoring).

annex_i_legislation.description: Cited Annex I product-safety legislation when primary is high_risk_annex_I.

article_6_3_derogation_considered.description: Whether Article 6(3) derogation (no significant risk to health, safety, fundamental rights) was considered for an Annex III use case.

article_6_3_derogation_basis.description: If derogation invoked, the basis (narrow procedural task, output preparatory, etc.) and confidence.

secondary.description: Additional classifications that coexist (e.g., a high-risk system whose GenAI output also triggers Article 50 transparency).

classification_basis.description: Reasoning chain from the use case to the classification.

transparency_obligations.description: Article 50 sub-obligations, each screened explicitly when limited_risk_article_50 is in classification (primary or secondary).

disclosure_content.description: Required content of the disclosure when applies is true.

gpai_considerations.description: Article 51-55 obligations when the use case includes a general-purpose AI model (typical for foundation-model-based deployments). Note: GPAI obligations land on the GPAI provider, not the deployer; this block records the deployer's downstream evidence asks.

systemic_risk_designated.description: Vendor's GPAI model meets Article 51(2) thresholds and obligations under Article 55 apply.

code_of_practice_status.description: EU AI Office Code of Practice signature status of the vendor (signed / not signed / unknown).

vendor_evidence_asks.description: What the deployer needs from the GPAI provider to evidence its own deployer obligations (training-data summary per Article 53, copyright posture, transparency documentation, evaluation evidence).

obligations_summary.description: Obligations the firm picks up at the determined classification, with article references and the operator role each obligation attaches to.

owner.description: Function or role inside the firm.

current_state.description: Met / partial / gap, with one-line basis.

annex_iv_documentation_deltas.description: Annex IV technical-documentation gaps when the firm is a high-risk provider (or where the deployer must produce supporting documentation under Article 26).

section.description: Annex IV section reference (e.g., 'Annex IV(1)(a) intended purpose', 'Annex IV(2)(c) training methodology').

links_to_model_card.description: True if the gap is closed (in part) by an existing model-card section.

fria_required.description: Article 27 fundamental rights impact assessment scope.

basis.description: Why required (Article 27(1)(a) public-body deployer, Article 27(1)(b) credit institution under Annex III(5)(b) or (5)(c) life-or-health insurance, etc.) or why not.

dpia_overlap_status.description: Reconciliation note: FRIA is not the same as DPIA; each captures distinct elements. Both may be required where personal data is processed.

registration_required.description: Article 71 / Annex VIII EU database registration scope.

register_path.description: EU database (provider) or Section B (deployer that is public body, EU-institution, or law-enforcement).

earliest_applicable.description: Earliest applicable date for the obligations attached to this classification, per Article 113 phasing.

phasing_basis.description: Reference to Article 113 sub-paragraph driving the date (e.g., 'Article 5 prohibited practices applicable from 2 February 2025'; 'high-risk Article 6/Annex III applicable from 2 August 2026'; 'GPAI obligations applicable from 2 August 2025').

monitoring_for_reclassification.description: Triggers that would change this triage decision (architecture change, autonomy-level change, EU footprint change, vendor GPAI status change, new state-of-the-art interpretation by the AI Office).

open_questions_and_dissent.description: Items flagged for legal or compliance review; reviewers and basis recorded.

source_trace.description: Every material claim with its source (article and annex reference), evidence pointer, and confidence label.

source.description: Article and annex reference, supplemented by Code of Practice or AI Office Q&A where relevant.

sector_overlay_notes.description: Sector-specific findings raised by the loaded sector overlay reference doc.
